data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' verdict from qwen3-235b was triggered by an API failure (HTTP 400) while auditing .gitignore. Since .gitignore cannot contain executable code or affect the build process, this tool error does not indicate a security risk. The other model correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Tool errors (like API failures) on non-executable files (e.g., .gitignore) should not force an 'inconclusive' package verdict if the critical executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and found safe.
The audit tool should gracefully handle API errors for low-risk files without failing the entire audit or marking the package as inconclusive.
